    'HBO Max':            '#B537F2',
    'YouTube Premium':    '#FF0000',
    'Hulu':               '#1CE783',
}

line_widths['Netflix'] = 4.0
line_widths['Disney+'] = 3.5
line_widths['Amazon Prime Video'] = 2.8
line_widths['Spotify'] = 2.8

alphas = {p: 0.55 for p in platforms}
alphas['Netflix'] = 1.0
alphas['Disney+'] = 1.0
alphas['Amazon Prime Video'] = 0.85
alphas['Spotify'] = 0.85
alphas['Hulu'] = 0.65
alphas['HBO Max'] = 0.65
alphas['YouTube Premium'] = 0.65
alphas['Apple TV+'] = 0.65

zorders['Disney+'] = 9
zorders['Amazon Prime Video'] = 8
zorders['Spotify'] = 7

ax.set_facecolor('#FAFBFC')

    valid_y = [y[i] for i in range(len(y)) if y[i] is not None]

        continue

    line_style = '-'
    marker_size = 7 if platform in ('Netflix', 'Disney+') else 5

        valid_x, valid_y,
        color=colors[platform],
        linewidth=line_widths[platform],
        alpha=alphas[platform],
        zorder=zorders[platform],
        linestyle=line_style,
        marker='o',
        markersize=marker_size,
        markerfacecolor=colors[platform],
        markeredgecolor='white',
        markeredgewidth=1.2,
        solid_capstyle='round',
        solid_joinstyle='round',
    )

        fontweight='bold',
        color=colors[platform],

    first_y = valid_y[0]

        ha='right',
        path_effects=outline,
        **text_props,

    last_y = valid_y[-1]
    ax.annotate(
        platform,
        xy=(last_x, last_y),
        xytext=(14, 0),
        textcoords='offset points',
        ha='left',
        path_effects=outline,
        **text_props,
    )

# Disney+ launch annotation

    'Disney+ launches\nNov 2019',

        color='#113CCF',
        lw=1.5,
        connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2'

    path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=3, foreground='#FAFBFC')],

ax.invert_yaxis()

ax.set_xticklabels(
    [quarters[i] for i in tick_positions],
    fontsize=9.5, rotation=35, ha='right', color='#555555'
)

ax.set_ylabel('Rank Position', fontsize=12, fontweight='semibold', color='#333333', labelpad=10)

    fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e',
    x=0.5, y=0.97, ha='center',
)

    'Quarterly rankings (Q1 2019 – Q1 2025)  ·  Rank #1 = most subscribers',
    fontsize=12, color='#666666', pad=12, fontstyle='italic',
)

# Shaded region for volatile lower-tier zone

ax.text(
    len(quarters) - 1 + 2.6, 6.5,
    'Competitive\nvolatility\nzone',
    fontsize=8.5, color='#888888', ha='right', va='center',

)

ax.text(
    len(quarters) - 1 + 2.6, 1.5,
    'Dominant\ntier',
    fontsize=8.5, color='#2d7d2d', ha='right', va='center',
    fontstyle='italic',
    path_effects=[pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='#FAFBFC')],
)

fig.text(
    0.5, 0.01,
    'Source: Industry analyst estimates based on publicly reported subscriber figures  |  Rank 1 = highest global subscribers',
    fontsize=8.5, color='#999999', ha='center', fontstyle='italic',
)
